annotations.title: Send Data safety to Google Play

description: Sends the Data safety answers kept in Ploa to Google Play through its API (Google's own CSV, every question), replacing the whole Data safety form in Play Console; Google then reviews it. Only for an agent its owner made autonomous (see ploa_access): otherwise a person presses Send to Google Play on the store setup page, and this says so. Save the answers with ploa_privacy_save first.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
